title: Wirelang Layer 0 — Transport (NATS + JetStream)
description: Schema for Wirelang Layer 0 transport-binding metadata. Validates NATS subject patterns and JetStream stream/consumer configuration shapes used by Wakir agents. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

binding.description: Transport binding identifier. Phase-1a is fixed to NATS+JetStream per ADR-0020 variant alpha.

subject.description: NATS subject decomposition following the wakir.<env>.<domain>.<event-type>[.<sub-id>] convention.

pattern.description: Full NATS subject string. Must match the Wakir hierarchical convention.

domain.description: Logical Wakir domain such as agent, wat, treasury, comms.

event_type.description: Reverse-DNS-style event type, identical to the CloudEvents 'type' attribute body.

sub_id.description: Optional granular sub-identifier (agent slug, task-id prefix).

retention_days.description: Retention window in days. Phase-1a default is 7; wat.* streams default to 14.

semantics.description: Phase-1a only supports at-least-once. Consumers MUST be idempotent against duplicate CloudEvents 'id' values.

ordering.description: Ordering guarantee. Cross-stream ordering is NOT guaranteed.

permissions.description: Account-scoped subject permissions reservation. Phase-1b populates this from JWT-SVID claims (ADR-0020).
